operator_equivalence.case: same corrective delta operator at packet 4-by-8 shape

program_comparison.meaning: Same finite-state induction family; SERA repeats transition queries to check observed determinism. This doubles transition feedback, not learning efficiency.

renamed_state_probe.sera_rejection: This program representation requires contiguous observed state IDs
renamed_state_probe.boundary: SERA narrows observable labels to contiguous zero-based IDs; the source discovery dictionary does not.

source_reproduction.scope: Supplementary source reproduction and direct restricted-model comparison. Earlier 36-core checkpoint/training evidence remains in its original release. Fresh outputs are separate from delivered source and frozen SERA results. Differences are reported without replacing history.

instrument_expansion_probe.interpretation: The operation is a fresh replacement, even at equal dimension; it is not a transfer-preserving expansion. No candidate was saved or promoted.

decision.assumptions: Fixed bounded scores; independent fresh examples conditional on prior search. Retention gates are empirical, not confidence bounds.

composite_retention_probe.interpretation: A 30-point prediction regression is hidden by higher control success in the composite world score. This demonstrates a boundary of the supplied scoring contract, not a regression observed in the three released promotions.

integration_checks.scope: Read-only reconstruction and in-memory probes. No archived model, journal, training record or result is modified. Equality of saved components demonstrates what persisted; it does not imply that the missing integration is impossible.

preservation.boundary: Verifies work present at review start. Git metadata, third-party environment and runtime caches are excluded. This is local preservation, not an off-device backup claim.

interpretation: This review distinguishes implemented mechanisms, changed prototypes, disconnected paths and proposed architecture families. It preserves old results and corrects completion claims. Local reproduction records retain their original bytes; this summary selects the cost fields and gives artifact hashes.
